2124. Checking Whether a Number Is Prime

90

Hard

Problem Statement
Read an integer and determine whether it is prime using a for loop combined with an if statement.

Description
Read an integer num from input (num > 1). Use a for loop with a counter starting at 2 and running up to num - 1, checking on each iteration whether num is exactly divisible by the counter using the % operator. Use a flag variable to record whether any divisor was found. After the loop, use an if-else statement to print "Prime" if no divisor was found, or "Not Prime" otherwise.
